notes: ἕως ἄν is taken as one aligned unit on *Till*, rule 50 forbidding an unrepresented ἄν and no other English word standing for it; rule 39's test keeps the status aligned, *Till* answering to ἕως.
δεξιῶν → *right hand* heads on *right* under rule 17's generic-noun clause, and the second attributive τῷ before ἁγίῳ is unrepresented under rule 23.
